summary: Create a faithful frontend-only mock of the Comms Hub app shown in the shared Power Apps link. The mock captures communication quality entries, review workflows, attachments, navigation, and lightweight local interactions without a backend.

workspaceSignals.decisionReason: An existing React + Vite frontend is present in the workspace and already contains a Comms Hub communication logging experience.

questions.question: Which programming language for Comms Hub Web App?
questions.rationale: The existing frontend uses JavaScript and JSX in src/App.jsx and src/main.jsx.

options.label: JavaScript
options.description: JavaScript with the existing JSX implementation

questions.question: Which frontend framework for Comms Hub Web App?
questions.rationale: package.json includes React, React DOM, Vite, and the React Vite plugin.

options.label: React + Vite
options.description: React with the existing Vite bundler

questions.question: Describe the features for Comms Hub Web App.
questions.answer: Communication entry form with brand, document type, error type, review chain, timeline, notes, attachments, local save feedback, navigation tabs, reset, and assistant action.
questions.rationale: The existing App.jsx already implements these visible mock interactions and fields.
questions.recommendedChoice: Communication entry form with brand, document type, error type, review chain, timeline, notes, attachments, local save feedback, navigation tabs, reset, and assistant action.

questions.question: Which data stores does your app need?
questions.rationale: This request is for a visual mock; existing form state and selected files are client-side only.

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: The mock does not persist data or use storage, queues, or caches

questions.question: Does this app need user login?
questions.rationale: The user requires Comms Hub users to sign in before accessing the application.

options.label: Yes
options.description: Add a user sign-in flow and authenticated API access

options.label: No
options.description: No user sign-in or authenticated API access
